the enzyme from E. faecalis, which has a preference for short‐chain substrates (C4 and C6), has a relatively large substrate‐binding pocket with an elongated acyl chain‐binding cavity, while the enzymes from the other species have relatively smaller binding pockets with shorter acyl chain‐ binding cavities.
